zh.setup_desc: 完成以下步骤即可让机器人跑起来
zh.setup_step_chat_description: 安装并启用 QQ / Telegram 等平台适配器
zh.setup_step_server_description: 安装鹊桥插件接入服务器，双方任一方主动连接均可
zh.setup_step_superuser_description: 设置管理员，获得管理命令权限
zh.setup_token_dialog_description: 在任意平台的群聊中发送下方认证令牌，即可自动完成初始化：本群加入消息群与指令群，发送者成为超级用户。
zh.setup_token_step_send: 在需要授权的平台群聊中发送该令牌；
zh.setup_token_step_auto: 机器人自动把本群加入消息群 / 指令群，并把发送者设为超级用户。
zh.setup_token_tip: 令牌即用即刷：使用一次后立即刷新，旧令牌自动作废；机器人启动时也会在控制台打印。

en.setup_desc: Complete these steps to get the bot running
en.setup_step_chat_description: Install and enable adapters such as QQ / Telegram
en.setup_step_server_description: Install the QueQiao plugin; either side can initiate the connection
en.setup_step_superuser_description: Set up admins to gain access to admin commands
en.setup_token_dialog_description: Send the token below in any platform group chat to finish initialization automatically: the group joins the message and command groups, and the sender becomes a superuser.
en.setup_token_step_send: Send it in the platform group chat you want to authorize;
en.setup_token_step_auto: The bot automatically adds the group to message / command groups and promotes the sender to superuser.
en.setup_token_tip: Tokens are single-use and refresh immediately after being used; old tokens become invalid. The token is also printed to the console when the bot starts.
